entries.zh: 节日；节庆（原注「魔鬼之节」，指异教祭鬼的节庆）
entries.en: festival; feast-day (lit. 'the devils' one', i.e. a heathen / ghost festival)
entries.notes: L 栏 'la sua de diablos' 当即 'la suya de diablos'，属限定语；H 栏只存通称「节」。

entries.en: solar term (one of the twenty-four Chinese solar terms)

entries.notes: R 栏非官话对音，而是一句西语夹注（q[ue] de luna háce[n] la fi[es]ta，「为月亮办节庆」）。

entries.en: to go out strolling; to take a walk for pleasure
entries.notes: M 栏 'cu poā' 一段与 H「游」不协，R 栏 'hūy hoy' 亦疑为西语残文，义依 L 栏推定。

entries.en: to stroll and make merry; to take one's ease out of doors
entries.notes: H 栏「仪」与 L「holgarse（取乐）」及 M 栏 'cū gālã' 均不协，疑 H 栏摹写有误，义依 L 栏推定。

entries.en: to walk to and fro; to pace about
entries.notes: H 栏第二字 [疑:來/表]，据 M 栏 'lāy'（來）定作「行來行去」。

entries.en: to stroll idly; to walk about with nothing to do
entries.notes: H 栏首字 [疑:閒/間]，按 L「no aviendo que hazer」及 M 'ēng' 定作「閒」。

entries.en: to take steps; to walk about
to move about; to go about
to travel all over the world; to roam everywhere
to roam the four quarters; to go about everywhere

entries.zh: 游街（押解人犯穿街示众）
entries.en: to parade through the streets (esp. a criminal led to justice)
entries.notes: L 栏 'a la justicia' 指押赴官府／刑场，故取「游街示众」义。
H、M、R 三栏全空，仅存西语词头 'Passion. f. afection'（激情、情欲），无汉语对音可定。
汉字栏空，L 栏仅标「partícula（虚词）」并残留 'gi-'，音写 'buŷ' 与官话 'gy' 无从复原所指虚词。

entries.zh: 麻（受寒而麻痹）；伤风、着凉
entries.en: numbness (from cold); a chill, cold in the head
(prob.) a braid or plait of hair
entries.notes: H 栏作「联」[疑:聯/聽]、M 'bīen' 与之不合，L 'Parguiney, di belos' 词源不明，只能推测与毛发编结有关。
